judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements `accumulateUsage` to sum token counts across provider calls while handling `undefined` rounds cleanly, and updates `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` with thorough unit and acceptance tests. However, it misses the fourth acceptance criterion requiring the hook signature itself to make the cumulative semantics unambiguous: despite claiming to do so in its `.lore/dod.md`, the candidate never updates the `afterModelResponse` parameter name (to `totalUsage`) in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, `CLAUDE.md`, or `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`, and even leaves the orchestrator local variable named `lastUsage`. It also places `accumulateUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` and adds a new `chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than extending `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` directly as the reference does.
